limitations: Phrase matches do not establish that the framing targets AI in every clause.
Statements, attribution, negation scope and sarcasm can be ambiguous; uncertain is retained.
Economic/social environmental and mental-health harms are grouped together.
Benefits and investment mentions may be descriptive rather than evaluative; ROI/capex alone may be a contextual false positive.
